thread:
Nina (csops): FYI we just noticed a reweight rollout pushed to production that dropped healthscore for ~1.2k accounts to 0. Renewal playbook started firing for a lot of low-touch customers. Pausing automation now.

Omar (eng-ml): ack. which rollout? i thought feature-flag `hs-reweight-v3` was still behind canary. can you paste the flag id and any rollout logs?

Nina (csops): flag id: hs-reweight-v3. rollout record: `2026-03-25T09:12:34Z by deploy-bot`. sample query that shows the drop: ```sql
SELECT account_id, previous_score, new_score, last_active_at FROM account_health_scores
WHERE updated_at >= '2026-03-25' AND new_score = 0 LIMIT 10;
```

Carlos (revenueops): omg — we already had a renewal cadence scheduled this week for a segment. can we bulk-suppress renewal nudges until this is sorted? we don't want churn nudges going to customers who are actually healthy.

Nina (csops): pausing playbook `renewal-nudge-v4` for all segments now. Playbook Bot, please abort any queued runs and mark affected contacts as suppressed with reason `healthscore_reweight_pause`.

Playbook Bot: abort request received for playbook `renewal-nudge-v4` by @Nina (csops). 1,253 queued actions canceled. Suppression tag applied: `healthscore_reweight_pause`. Logs: gs://redwood-cs/playbooks/aborts/1716604321-abort.log

Omar (eng-ml): thanks. i will rollback the last parameter change and run a dry recalculation. quick plan: 1) rollback to baseline weights (hs-weight-202602), 2) run backfill recompute for affected accounts, 3) diff and sanity-check, 4) re-apply if safe. i'll post job ids.

Nina (csops): also need a clean export of affected accounts for Revenue + Enablement so they can review before any outreach. include fields: account_owner, ARR, last_contact, recommended_pause_reason.

Carlos (revenueops): prioritize accounts with ARR > 25k for manual review. i can pull owners and reassign if someone is OOO.

Omar (eng-ml): kicked off recompute job id `recompute-171660`. estimated time ~18m. results will be in BigQuery table `backfill_recompute_171660`. sample job CLI: ```bash
./recompute_scores --job recompute-171660 --input accounts_affected.csv --weights hs-weight-202602 --output backfill_recompute_171660
```

Nina (csops): thanks. i'll create a Confluence checklist and a one-pager for enablement. also adding a short-run playbook to rehydrate scores if recompute succeeds. sample playbook config: ```yaml
playbook: healthscore-rehydrate-v1
mode: dry_run # will flip to task_open for ARR > 25k
filters:
  - affected_tag: healthscore-reweight-2026-03-25
  - min_arr: 25000
routing:
  - owner: account_owner
  - escalation: revenue_ops
```

Healthscore Service: recompute-171660 completed. summary: 1,253 affected accounts processed, 86 accounts still have new_score=0 after rollback (investigate). output table: bq:redwood_prod.backfill_recompute_171660.

Omar (eng-ml): drilling into the 86 now. looks like ~40 are truly inactive (no events > 180 days), 28 have malformed telemetry (missing last_active_at), and 18 are suspicious (score stayed 0 despite activity). i'll open a small ticket for telemetry fixes.

Carlos (revenueops): thanks. for the 40 inactive ones let's keep suppression and skip outreach. for the 18 suspicious, please add `requires_enablement_review` to the export.

Nina (csops): exporting CSV with tags. link: gs://redwood-cs/backfills/1716604321-affected_accounts.csv. counts: total 1,253; flagged_manual_review: 78 (ARR>25k or suspicious); suppressed_auto: 415 (inactive); to_task_for_owner: 760.

Carlos (revenueops): i'll coordinate owner reassignments for the 78 manual items. want to pause any renewal cadence triggers until owners confirm.

Playbook Bot: scheduled `healthscore-rehydrate-v1` in dry_run mode by @Nina (csops). dry_run summary: simulated actions 1,253; suggested tasks 78. report: gs://redwood-cs/playbooks/reports/1716604321-dryrun.json

Omar (eng-ml): follow-up: telemetry ticket created `TELEM-455` for missing last_active_at sources. estimated fix in next deploy.

Nina (csops): next steps recap: 1) Carlos to hold renewal cadence and reassign owners for 78 manual reviews, 2) Omar to validate recompute and follow up on TELEM-455, 3) Nina to flip playbook to task_open for ARR>25k once owners confirmed, 4) Healthscore Service to run nightly reconcile for the affected cohort for 7 days.

Carlos (revenueops): on it. i'll post owner reassignment list here by EOD.

Nina (csops): thanks all. marking this thread as the coordination log for the incident and linking Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CS/2026-03-25+healthscore-reweight-incident

Healthscore Service: nightly reconcile scheduled `nightly-reconcile-171660` for 7 days. monitoring alerts will be sent to #incidents if discrepancy > 5%.
